title: Measurement Observation
description: The recorded result of a Measurement. A MeasurementObservation is a sibling of the existing assessment-side dea:Observation (CR-5 27) on the assessment-vs-measurement axis; the two are distinct concepts and MUST NOT be merged, re-membershiped, or supersed-ed. (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002; user clarification 2026-10-18; full attribute set in CR-MET-003 and CR-MET-011.)

produced_by.description: Reference to the dea:Measurement that produced this observation. Cardinality 1:0..1 (a MeasurementObservation is the result of one Measurement; a Measurement MAY produce zero or more observations).

value.description: The recorded value. Typed to support the four measurement_nature values from the parent Metric: numeric (number), ordinal (number or string), nominal (string), boolean (boolean), composite (object).

unit.description: Optional reference to the unit registry per CR-MET-005. Required when the parent Metric has measurement_nature: numeric.

temporal.description: Temporal context (when the value was obtained). Full specification in CR-MET-011.

confidence.description: Optional confidence value in the range 0..1.
